**Install:** download `FileLocker-Setup.exe` below and run it. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway** (the app isn't code-signed yet). No administrator password needed.

At the end of setup, choose your PIN or password and **save the recovery key**.

See the [README](https://github.com/olamideba/filelocker#readme) for how to use it.
